messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Hg19 bed files from ucsc tablebrowser tool errors out when read by methylKit
parts:
are you sure you are putting the data in "extdata" folder of the installation directory? if you are calling system.file() like that it tries to find the data in the installation directory. You can just give the full path to refseqGeneshg19.BED.txt

Best,
Altuna

I changed the command to 

gene.obj=read.transcript.features(file.path("/proj","intermediate","methylkitAnnotationFiles","refseqGeneshg19.BED.txt"))

and it worked fine.

Best,
-Rob
